name: Vantablack Signals Security Escort Uniform
description:
Vantablack's escort security operatives occupy a different role than their analyst counterparts — they are physically present, visible, and intended to project a specific kind of deterrence. Their uniform reflects this: a structured black jacket over matching tactical trousers, with a matte-finish chest rig that carries no visible weapon mounts but has hardpoints rated for rapid attachment of Vantablack-issued equipment. The jacket's fabric incorporates the same light-absorption weave used in analyst suits, making the wearer appear slightly flattened in recording environments — useful when accompanying clients who require discretion about their security arrangements. A single white Vantablack sigil — the only visible branding — is set into the left collar in reflective thread visible only under direct light.

The chest rig is the operationally significant element. Its front panels are layered with soft armor rated for standard ballistics, and the rear panel carries a signal-isolation membrane that provides limited protection against directed-energy BCI disruption — a threat taken seriously in Vantablack's operational environment. The uniform is sized and cut to accommodate significant augmentation; the jacket back has a full-length magnetic closure panel for operatives with extensive dorsal chrome, and sleeve lengths are available in extended cuts for arm-augmented personnel. Geneware accommodations are not standard issue — Vantablack's escort division maintains strict physical specifications that functionally exclude most significant geneware modifications, a policy that has generated quiet external criticism and internal legal review.
cultural_context: A Vantablack escort operative accompanying a client is a visible statement of resources and threat level. In GLMZ's Tier 4 and 5 spaces, the uniform reads as a signal to other security professionals, corporate rivals, and journalists alike. The exclusion of geneware-modified operatives from Vantablack's escort division is an ongoing point of controversy in both labor and civil rights discussions in the city.
story_hooks: A Vantablack escort operative approaches a character privately during an assignment — they have information they want to pass on without Vantablack's knowledge.
The signal-isolation membrane in a recovered uniform has been modified to do the opposite of its stated function — it's broadcasting rather than blocking.
A geneware-modified ex-Vantablack applicant is filing a discrimination case and needs documentation of the physical specification policy in practice.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, imposing silhouette designed to absorb attention and light simultaneously. The wearer appears almost dimensionally flattened — a visual trick that makes them blend into shadows while remaining unmistakably present. The jacket creates a severe, geometric profile; the chest rig adds tactical authority without visible weaponry. Overall impression: a void wrapped in intention.
physical_description.fit: Structured and tailored with athletic accommodation. The jacket is cut to sit close to the torso while allowing freedom of movement through the shoulders and arms. Trousers are fitted through the hips and thighs, relaxing slightly at the calf. The chest rig sits flush against the body, anchored by magnetic points. Sleeves and inseams available in extended cuts for augmented personnel.
physical_description.primary_material: Jacket and trousers: proprietary light-absorption weave (Vantablack's signature fabric — microstructured synth-composite that traps photons). Chest rig: ballistic-rated soft armor laminate with signal-isolation membrane backing. Closures: magnetic-lock panels and friction-fit tactical hardware.
physical_description.texture: Matte throughout — the jacket presents a velvety, almost absorbent surface that seems to pull light inward. The chest rig has a slightly textured weave over the armor panels, providing grip. Seams are reinforced and topstitched in matte black thread. No shine, no reflection, no give.
physical_description.color_scheme: Absolute black with single accent: a reflective white Vantablack sigil (geometric, angular) set into the left collar in thread that only registers under direct light — invisible under most circumstances, creating an Easter egg of branding.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap closure down the jacket front (silent, secure, tool-free). Full-length magnetic panel on jacket back for dorsal-augmented operatives. Chest rig anchors via magnetic hardpoints and friction-fit tactical attachments. No traditional zippers — all closures are silent and tool-independent.
distinctive_features: Light-absorption weave that flattens appearance in recording environments
Hardened chest rig with ballistic soft armor and signal-isolation membrane (BCI disruption protection)
Full-length magnetic back panel accommodating dorsal chrome
Extended sleeve/inseam options for cyberlimb-augmented personnel
Reflective white sigil collar mark (visible only under direct light)
No visible weapon mounts — deterrence through presence rather than visible hardware
Geneware modifications not accommodated — anatomically assumes baseline or cyber-augmented physiology only
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 access. Tier 4 working-class operatives wear this through employment; Tier 5 sub-grade individuals acquire it through black-market channels or salvage, where it signals either former contractor status or theft.
physical_description.cultural_context: The uniform announces: *This person is armed with authority and resources.* In GLMZ's lower tiers, a Vantablack escort uniform is a statement of either significant employment or significant danger. The visible sigil is a quiet flex — only those who know Vantablack's branding recognize the threat. The exclusion of geneware-modified operatives is a coded message about Vantablack's internal hierarchy and physical standards, a controversial policy that marks the company as operating within strict baseline-human specifications.
physical_description.condition_typical: Maintained in near-pristine condition. Operatives are required to keep gear field-ready. Worn examples show subtle scuffing on the chest rig panels, slight fading on magnetic closure points, and careful patching of minor ballistic impacts. The fabric's light-absorption properties make wear patterns nearly invisible.
